_about: Public-domain Sir John William Dawson (1820-1899), Presbyterian geologist and principal of McGill University, for the Word Hoard: his writings on Scripture and science only: Archaia, Nature and the Bible, The Origin of the World according to Revelation and Science, Fictions and Errors, Points of Contact between Revelation and Natural Science, Facts and Fancies in Modern Science, Egypt and Syria, Modern Science in Bible Lands, The Historical Deluge, Modern Ideas of Evolution, The Day of Rest, Eden Lost and Won, and Science the Ally of Religion. His geology and university papers are left out. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 102 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
